title: VeNet: a lightweight neural network for efficient brain vessel segmentation in endovascular robotic surgery.
summary: VeNet is a lightweight 3D vessel-segmentation model tested with subject-separated cross-validation and an expert-annotated cerebral-vessel dataset; the article reports segmentation and resource-use results, and an annotated dataset contribution. This is a specific medical-imaging resource/segmentation outcome, without claim of clinical validation or deployment.
